description: This file implements the AzureBasedReminderTable class, which is a partial implementation of the IReminderTable interface. It manages reminder entries stored in Azure Table Storage, providing methods to initialize, read, upsert, and delete reminder entries, with detailed logging and error handling.

classes.name: AzureBasedReminderTable
classes.description: A class that implements reminder table operations using Azure Table Storage, including initialization, CRUD operations, and associated logging.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Initializes the reminder table, retries on failure, and signals when initialization completes.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Cancels initialization if ongoing and completes the task.

methods.name: TestOnlyClearTable
methods.description: Clears the reminder table for testing purposes after ensuring initialization.

methods.name: ReadRows
methods.description: Reads reminder entries for a specific grain or range, returning parsed reminder data.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a specific reminder entry for a grain and reminder name.

methods.name: UpsertRow
methods.description: Inserts or updates a reminder entry in the table.

methods.name: RemoveRow
methods.description: Removes a reminder entry conditionally based on ETag.
